g_policy.reason: The offer copy states the one-hour reward before the user chooses to play. The decline and ad-failure paths leave the menu unchanged and grant no unverified reward.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is time using Search, not cash or a transferable or externally exchangeable item.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is a return to the profile menu from Upgrade, not anything typed or said in a chat.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The reward and its expiry time-box access to Search, although the Search tab is already available at s01.e67. That caps something users get free today, despite the proposal's 'removes nothing free' field.

g_brand_safety.reason: The placement is a card in the safe s09 profile-menu drawer, away from chats and character content.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This is an existing_anchor, but the model shows no charge or limit on Search, the resource the reward gives.

c2_evidence.reason: The 'what makes it work here' field claims Search has name and trait filters, but the model lists s05 only as a Search screen and does not observe those filters.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: An hour of Search is not one of the Janitor+ benefits listed in m02, and the reward is time-limited.

c5_moment.reason: The card appears in the profile menu after the user returns from the Upgrade entry; it does not interrupt an ongoing task.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The flow uses a chosen sponsored game and the ad-failure path withholds the reward if play is not verified. Returning to the menu is an app-detectable trigger.

c7_specific.reason: The idea names this app's Search tab and the Upgrade to Janitor Plus entry in s09.
